description: This script generates a JSON description of the GN build environment for the ANGLE project, used to facilitate building Android.bp files for Android's Soong build system. It includes functions to retrieve and recursively load build dependencies based on GN labels, and outputs a JSON file with build info.

methods.name: get_json_description
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the JSON description of a GN target using subprocess to call 'gn desc'.

methods.name: load_json_deps
methods.description: Recursively loads dependencies of a target from the JSON description, updating the all_desc dictionary.

methods.name: create_build_description
methods.description: Creates a JSON build description for specified targets by calling GN and loading dependencies.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Sets up argument parsing, calls create_build_description, and writes the output JSON file.
